skill: wk-worktree-cleanup
date: 2026-06-25
type: pattern
severity: low
---

Treat `.agents/` and `skills-lock.json` as disposable even when not gitignored.

**What happened:** Pre-delete content scan flagged `.agents/` and `skills-lock.json` as untracked non-gitignored files, requiring manual judgment before cleanup could proceed.

**Root cause:** The disposable-paths classifier only recognizes gitignored paths and common OS/editor artifacts; agent infrastructure files generated by the skills tool system fall outside that set even though they carry no unique session context.

**Suggested fix:** Extend the disposable-paths classifier with explicit entries for agent infrastructure artifacts: `.agents/`, `skills-lock.json`, `.review-playground/`. These are always regenerated on next run and never hold unique content.
